resources.string:
ArthaLedger reads payment messages from banks and UPI apps on this phone and turns them into entries. You review them before anything is added.

• Messages are read on your phone only. They are never uploaded or shared. Only the entries you choose are saved to your account.
• Personal messages and OTPs are skipped.
• Nothing is added until you choose.

To add entries from bank SMS, allow SMS for ArthaLedger in Settings.\n\nIf Android calls it a restricted setting, open ArthaLedger’s App info, tap ⋮ (top right) → Allow restricted settings, then allow SMS.
This needs Google Chrome, installed and up to date.
